_README: REGISTERED PLANTS. A plant is a defect deliberately introduced to prove a
gate can fail (TC-2). It is a TEMPORARY state and must never be committed.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. `check_no_plants.mjs` matched textual markers, and a
lane wrote one the pattern did not anticipate: it caught `G8 PLANT` and
walked past `PLANT 2 — approximate the denominator instead of refusing`,
which would have shipped a FABRICATED DENOMINATOR to users — a plausible
percentage for a figure whose real share is unknown. Broadening the regex
closed that one shape; the next lane will invent a different one.
Markers are lane-authored, so a convention only one side follows is not a
- a suspicious shape in product source must be REGISTERED here, or the
- a registered entry whose plant is ABSENT also fails, so a stale
registration cannot silently widen the allowance.
An entry is only ever correct WHILE a plant is live. The steady state of
this file is an empty `plants` array.
